summary: SEALSQ Corp filed a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing preliminary H1 2026 financial results. Revenue grew 120% year-over-year to ~$11 million, with ~$495 million in cash and short-term investments. The company reaffirmed FY 2026 revenue growth guidance of 50%-100%. The filing details operational updates, including the consolidation of IC ALPS SAS acquired in August 2025 and strategic investments in quantum technology ventures. No special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is disclosed. The 6-K is a routine foreign private issuer report of financial performance and business updates.
